findings.description: Model file contains three identical definitions each for CallLog, Note, and Email classes. Python will only recognize the last definition, causing runtime errors, import failures, and unpredictable behavior. Remove duplicate definitions and keep only one of each class.

The notes table creates lead_id column but lacks foreign key constraint to business_leads table. This breaks referential integrity, allows orphaned records, and risks database inconsistencies. Add: sa.ForeignKeyConstraint(['lead_id'], ['business_leads.id'], ondelete='SET NULL')

Read endpoints (GET) for call-logs, notes, and emails lack authentication verification. Write operations correctly use verify_api_key but reads are unprotected, exposing sensitive CRM data. Add verify_api_key dependency to all GET endpoints for these resources.

CallLogForm stores datetime-local input value directly but defaults to ISO format on submission, creating inconsistency. User-entered times in local format may be misinterpreted. Convert datetime-local to ISO before submission: new Date(callStartedAt).toISOString()
